scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette, clean search UI with inline match count, and collapsed-node descendant badges show genuine design craft, but the bottom half of the viewport is wasted whitespace and the legend sits in the SVG layer instead of fixed chrome, making it scroll away.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no quantitative encoding to deceive — color is categorical (Tol palette by rank), circle size is a binary leaf/non-leaf distinction, SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent, and descendant counts are text labels rather than scaled visuals; minor robustness weakness is the key function (name+depth instead of a stable unique ID) but no active deception exists.
scores.stress_test_note: No brush/zoom so update-storm and stale-scale risks are absent, search is debounced 200ms, and pointer events prevent mouse-touch fights, but no .interrupt() call precedes any transition so rapid clicks or expand-all during a 500ms animation will queue mid-flight conflicts.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Progressive collapse keeps visible nodes to ~12 in the initial state, search auto-expands matched paths, and 6-color rank legend is legible — cognitive load is well-managed for a 200-node taxonomy; animation quality can't be assessed from screenshot but code uses staged enter/update/exit transitions with reduced-motion support.
